units.source_text: 這樣說聽起來蠻奇怪的，但就算我飢腸轆轆，也真的感覺不到肚子餓。

en.t: It may sound rather strange to say this, but even when I was ravenous, I truly could not feel hungry.

units.source_text: 在上小學和中學時，每次放學回到家裡，

en.t: When I was in elementary and middle school, every time I came home after class,

units.source_text: 周圍的人就會七嘴八舌地說道：「肚子餓了吧？

en.t: the people around me would all start saying at once, "You must be hungry, right?

units.source_text: 我們都記憶猶新呢，放學後肚子餓的難受勁兒。

en.t: We still remember very clearly how awful that hunger after school felt.

units.source_text: 吃點甜納豆怎麼樣？還有蛋糕和麵包呢。」

en.t: How about some sweet natto? There is cake and bread too."

units.source_text: 而我也會乘機發揮天生喜歡討好人的秉性，小聲說著「肚子餓了」，

en.t: And I would take the chance to display my inborn habit of trying to please people, softly saying, "I am hungry,"

units.source_text: 然後把十幾粒甜納豆塞進嘴裡。

en.t: and then stuff a dozen or so sweet natto beans into my mouth.

units.source_text: 可是，肚子餓到底是何種感覺，我一點都不知道。

en.t: But I had no idea at all what the feeling of hunger actually was.
Of course, I could eat a great deal too.

units.source_text: 但幾乎沒有因飢餓而吃的記憶。

en.t: But I have almost no memory of eating because I was hungry.

units.source_text: 我吃眾人眼中的山珍海味，以及奢侈的大餐。

en.t: I ate delicacies that everyone regarded as rare treats, and I ate luxurious feasts as well.
